Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/

│          └── flux2-vae.safetensors
```
## Report issue

Note: please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud will be updated after the stable release; nightly-supported models may not be included yet, please wait for the next stable release.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

Example "Scene Interaction" Phrases

Text standing on the sandy bottom.Text slightly covered with sand and small stones

The text rests on the ground between the trees. The text is lightly covered by roots, soil, and small stones.

The text stands on the road in a puddle, reflected in the water.

The text sticks out from the broken asphalt on the road. The text is covered in dust. Rocks and asphalt are scattered around.

The text is standing on the ground. The text is lightly covered at the bottom with fallen leaves and soil.

The text stands in molten lava. The bottom of the text is red-hot and starting to crack.

underwater_corals:

Text standing on the sandy bottom, surrounded by colorful fish
Text resting on a coral reef, covered in small barnacles and algae
Text floating in the water, light rays shining through from above

underwater_deep:

Text floating in the dark deep water, bioluminescent glow
Text drifting in the current, bubbles rising around it

🚀 (Space)
space_nebula:

Text floating in zero gravity, reflection of nebula on the surface
Text drifting through space debris, illuminated by distant stars

space_stars_field:

Text hovering in the void, faint stardust settling on top

🏙 (City)
city_night_neon:

Text standing on wet asphalt, neon lights reflecting in puddles
Text hanging on a brick wall, rain drops sliding down
Text standing on the street, wet surface reflection

city_day_busy:

Text standing on the sidewalk, blurred people walking by
Text mounted on a building facade, casting a shadow
🌲 (Forest)
forest_mystical:

Text half-buried in moss and ferns, fireflies hovering nearby
Text standing on the forest floor, roots wrapping around the base

forest_autumn:

Text lying on the ground, covered in colorful fallen leaves
Text standing in tall dry grass, fog at the base
🏜️ (Extreme)
desert_sandstorm:

Text half-buried in sand dunes, wind erosion effect
Text standing in the desert, sand particles hitting the surface

ice_cave:

Text encased in solid ice, frost crystals on the edges
Text standing on frozen ground, icy mist around the base

lava_cave:

Text standing on cracked hot rock, lava glow from below
Text floating above magma, heat distortion effect
🎨 (Abstract & Textures)
abstract_vortex:

Text disintegrating into particles, sucked into the vortex

grid_cyberpunk:

Text glitching on the grid surface, holographic projection
old_paper:

Text written in ink on old paper, slightly faded and stained
Text burnt into the paper edges, vintage texture

concrete_wall:

Text spray-painted on the concrete, dripping paint effect
Text carved into the concrete wall, cracks and dust around it
